learning_objectives: VUS von pathogenen/likely pathogenen BRCA/HRR-Varianten therapeutisch trennen.
Tumor-, HRD- und Keimbahnebene sauber kommunizieren.
PARP-Indikation nicht auf eine ungesicherte VUS stützen.
deep_dive.opening_scene: Die Gyn-Onkologie stellt eine Patientin nach Platinansprechen vor. Im Tumorpanel wurde eine BRCA2-Variante unklarer Signifikanz gefunden. Die Frage lautet: 'Können wir das als BRCA-positiv werten und PARP-Erhaltung begründen?'
deep_dive.case_briefing: 59-jährige Patientin mit high-grade serösem Ovarialkarzinom, FIGO IIIC, gutes partielles Ansprechen auf Platin-basierte Erstlinientherapie. Familienanamnese: eine Tante mit Mammakarzinom, Details unklar. Tumorpanel: TP53 pathogene Mutation, BRCA2-Missense-Variante als VUS klassifiziert.

context_cards.content: HGSOC ist häufig TP53-alteriert; HRD/BRCA-Status kann therapeutisch relevant sein.
context_cards.teaching_point: Nicht jede BRCA-Variante ist automatisch HRD- oder PARP-begründend.

context_cards.title: Variante
context_cards.content: BRCA2-Missense-Variante, VAF 48%, keine gesicherte funktionelle Evidenz, keine klare Loss-of-function-Konsequenz.
context_cards.teaching_point: VAF und Genname allein reichen nicht für Pathogenität.

context_cards.title: HRD
context_cards.content: HRD-Score liegt noch nicht vor. Genomische Narben wurden im bisherigen Tumorpanel nicht ausreichend bewertet.
context_cards.teaching_point: HRD kann unabhängig von einer einzelnen VUS relevant sein.

context_cards.title: Keimbahn
context_cards.content: Eine humangenetische Abklärung kann aufgrund Entität/Familienkontext sinnvoll sein, muss aber getrennt von der somatischen VUS-Therapieaussage kommuniziert werden.
context_cards.teaching_point: Keimbahnklärung macht eine VUS nicht automatisch therapeutisch gesichert.

deep_dive.title: HGSOC with a BRCA2 VUS: request for PARP therapy, limits of evidence and germline communication
learning_objectives: Therapeutically distinguish a VUS from pathogenic/likely pathogenic BRCA/HRR variants.
Clearly communicate the tumour, HRD and germline levels.
Do not base a PARP indication on an unconfirmed VUS.
deep_dive.opening_scene: The gynaecological oncology team presents a patient after a response to platinum. A BRCA2 variant of uncertain significance was found on the tumour panel. The question is: 'Can we consider this BRCA-positive and use it to justify PARP maintenance therapy?'
deep_dive.case_briefing: A 59-year-old woman with high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, FIGO IIIC, and a good partial response to platinum-based first-line therapy. Family history: an aunt with breast cancer; details are unclear. Tumour panel: pathogenic TP53 mutation and a BRCA2 missense variant classified as a VUS.

context_cards.title: Tumour biology
context_cards.content: HGSOC frequently harbours TP53 alterations; HRD/BRCA status may be therapeutically relevant.
context_cards.teaching_point: Not every BRCA variant automatically establishes HRD or supports PARP therapy.

context_cards.title: Variant
context_cards.content: BRCA2 missense variant, VAF 48%, with no established functional evidence and no clear loss-of-function consequence.
context_cards.teaching_point: VAF and the gene name alone are insufficient to establish pathogenicity.

context_cards.title: HRD
context_cards.content: The HRD score is not yet available. Genomic scars were not adequately assessed by the previous tumour panel.
context_cards.teaching_point: HRD may be relevant independently of an individual VUS.

context_cards.title: Germline
context_cards.content: Clinical genetic evaluation may be appropriate because of the tumour entity and family context, but it must be communicated separately from the therapeutic interpretation of the somatic VUS.
context_cards.teaching_point: Germline evaluation does not automatically make a VUS therapeutically established.

deep_dive.decision_task: Formulate a technically sound recommendation regarding the BRCA2 VUS, HRD testing, the PARP context and germline evaluation.
expected_path: Do not report the BRCA2 VUS as a pathogenic or therapeutically established mutation.
Add HRD status or appropriate HRR/genomic-scar testing when therapeutically relevant.

deep_dive.decision_task: Formulați o recomandare corectă din punct de vedere profesional privind VUS BRCA2, testarea HRD, contextul PARP și evaluarea germinală.
expected_path: Nu raportați VUS BRCA2 drept mutație patogenă sau bază terapeutică dovedită.
Completați cu statutul HRD sau cu testare HRR/a cicatricilor genomice adecvată, dacă este relevantă terapeutic.
Documentați clasificarea VUS și nivelul dovezilor și nu formulați o recomandare terapeutică doar pe această bază.
Recomandați separat consilierea genetică medicală/testarea germinală, în special având în vedere entitatea tumorală și contextul familial.
Comunicare în MTB: VUS ≠ BRCA-pozitiv; decizia terapeutică trebuie bazată pe ghiduri, HRD și contextul clinic.
acceptable_alternatives: Dacă există deja un rezultat extern HRD-pozitiv, contextul PARP poate fi discutat independent de VUS.
Dacă materialul este insuficient, prioritizați HRD față de HRR extins în funcție de întrebarea clinică.

twist.why_critical: Dorința de a avea o opțiune terapeutică nu trebuie să modifice clasificarea dovezilor.

debrief_points: O VUS este o categorie de dovezi, nu o etichetă pentru terapia dorită.
Constatările somatice, HRD și nivelul germinal sunt trei niveluri interconectate, dar distincte.
Comunicarea corectă a rezultatului protejează împotriva supratratamentului și a consilierii familiale incorecte.

deep_dive.opening_scene: Η γυναικολογική ογκολογική ομάδα παρουσιάζει ασθενή μετά από ανταπόκριση σε πλατινούχο θεραπεία. Στο πάνελ όγκου ανιχνεύθηκε παραλλαγή BRCA2 αβέβαιης σημασίας. Το ερώτημα είναι: «Μπορούμε να τη θεωρήσουμε BRCA-θετική και να τεκμηριώσουμε θεραπεία συντήρησης με PARP;»
deep_dive.case_briefing: Γυναίκα 59 ετών με υψηλού βαθμού ορώδες καρκίνωμα ωοθήκης, FIGO IIIC, και καλή μερική ανταπόκριση σε πρώτης γραμμής πλατινούχο θεραπεία. Οικογενειακό ιστορικό: θεία με καρκίνο μαστού, χωρίς σαφείς λεπτομέρειες. Πάνελ όγκου: παθογόνος μετάλλαξη TP53 και missense παραλλαγή BRCA2 ταξινομημένη ως VUS.
